# Waves and Cobblestones

> > A travel resource exploring cruise destinations and coastal ports, with expertise in Mexican Riviera cruising.

Waves and Cobblestones provides detailed guides for cruise travelers, focusing on port destinations along the Mexican Riviera including Puerto Vallarta, Cabo San Lucas, Mazatlan, and Ensenada. The site helps travelers plan memorable shore excursions and coastal adventures.

## Key Topics

- Mexican Riviera
- Cabo San Lucas
- Puerto Vallarta
- Mazatlan
- Ensenada
- Catalina
- cruise ports
- port guides
- Mexico travel
- coastal destinations
- cruise travel
- shore excursions
